messages:
anna_dev: quick q — seeing a bunch of PagerDuty alerts labeled inference-hosted-prod but they're routing to an old rotation. where do we keep the routing/escalation rules and who owns the PD service? also where should I look for logs/traces for the failing requests?

sara_sre: routing is set in the PagerDuty service for inference-prod (Escalation Policy = 'Inference Oncall'). owners: @mike_oncall and @sara_sre. Slack integration posts into #eng-oncall via the PagerDuty app. check the PD service page: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/services/P12345 

mike_oncall: short answer — either the alert is still using the legacy PD service key or alertmanager receiver is pointing to the wrong service_key. common place to look: monitoring alertmanager configmap in k8s. example:
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring get configmap alertmanager -o yaml | sed -n '1,200p' | grep -n "inference-prod"
```
if you find a receiver like `pagerduty_inference_old` that's the culprit.

opsbot: deploy-bot: alertmanager config updated in staging earlier today (rollout id: deploy-2026-03-15-48).

anna_dev: okay thanks — where are the traces? should I look in Tempo/Jaeger or do we forward traces elsewhere?

sara_sre: traces for inference paths are in Tempo (linked in Grafana). dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/inference-prod-overview and the traces link on the top-right will open Tempo/Jaeger. logs: use Loki -> query `{app="inference", env="prod"}` and then filter by request_id or span_id.

jordan: ping — do I need PD org admin to change service -> escalation policy? or can I just swap the integration key?

mike_oncall: you don't need org admin to update service if you have Power User on that service. if not, open an ops ticket (ops queue) and tag @sara_sre. temporary fix: update alert label mapping in Alertmanager to point to the correct receiver (requires k8s cluster editor).

pd-bot: Incoming sample incident payload for reference:
```json
{
  "routing_key": "PAGERDUTY_SERVICE_KEY",
  "event_action": "trigger",
  "payload": {
    "summary": "High 5xx rate on inference-hosted-prod",
    "source": "alertmanager",
    "severity": "critical",
    "custom_details": {"prometheus": "rule=High5xxRate"}
  }
}
```

anna_dev: great, i'll check alertmanager receivers and search for old keys. if i open an ops ticket, what's the template?

sara_sre: use the "oncall-config-change" ops template. include cluster, configmap name, snippet of receiver, and desired PD service id. I'll review once you file it. :thumbsup:

mike_oncall: FYI, if you find the old key, rotate it after fix so incidents don't hit legacy rotation.

anna_dev: thanks all — i'll update here after i file the ticket and/or push a config change.
__note: Slack thread string contains root + replies in order; no title field per agents.md rules. messages are short and include links, code blocks, and bot notices.
